subject.title: fix(model-selection): warn on duplicate model aliases

question: Should duplicate model aliases preserve the existing last-match winner, intentionally change to first-match, or become invalid configuration?
rationale: The PR changes which configured provider/model is selected for existing files, and repository policy treats provider routing and fallback/default behavior as compatibility-sensitive; source inspection cannot decide that product contract safely.

options.title: Warn and preserve last-match
options.body: Keep current routing semantics, emit a sanitized warning from the shared alias construction path, and cover every resolver family.

options.title: Adopt first-match precedence
options.body: Approve the behavior change explicitly and require upgrade documentation plus fresh-install and existing-config proof showing the new winner.

options.title: Reject duplicate aliases
options.body: Fail validation or repair duplicates through Doctor, with an explicit migration path before runtime assumes uniqueness.

recommendation.title: Warn and preserve last-match
recommendation.body: Keep current routing semantics, emit a sanitized warning from the shared alias construction path, and cover every resolver family.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent model-discovery work makes this the strongest available owner for the compatibility contract.
